name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)

ministry.name: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
ministry.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

overview: A central sector scheme providing income support to all landholding farmer families in the country to supplement their financial needs for agriculture and allied activities.
objectives: Provide income support to landholding farmer families
Supplement financial needs for agricultural inputs
Ensure proper crop health and appropriate yields

benefits.title: Direct Income Support
benefits.description: Rs. 6,000 per year transferred in three equal installments of Rs. 2,000 directly to bank accounts

otherCriteria: Landholding farmer family as per state land records

customQuestions.question: Is your family a landholding farmer family?
Does your family own cultivable agricultural land according to the land records of the concerned State/UT?
Is the landholding in the name of you or a member of your farmer family?
Is your family an institutional landholder?
Is any member of your family a former or present constitutional post holder?
Is any member of your family a serving or retired government employee, excluding eligible MTS/Class IV/Group D employees?
Does any member of your family receive a monthly pension of Γé╣10,000 or more from the specified government-service categories?
Has any member of your family paid income tax in the last assessment year?
Is any member of your family a practising doctor, engineer, lawyer, chartered accountant or architect registered with the relevant professional body?
Is your Aadhaar authenticated for PM-KISAN registration?
Have you completed the required eKYC?

applicationProcess.description: Register on the PM-KISAN portal or through Common Service Centre
Provide Aadhaar, land and bank details
Receive funds via Direct Benefit Transfer

faqs.question: How much financial support is given?
faqs.answer: Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal installments.

faqs.question: Who is not eligible?
faqs.answer: Institutional landholders and certain higher-income categories as per scheme guidelines are excluded.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)

ministry.name: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
ministry.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

overview: A crop insurance scheme that provides financial support to farmers in the event of crop failure due to natural calamities, pests and diseases.
objectives: Provide insurance coverage against crop loss
Stabilise farmer income and ensure credit flow
Encourage adoption of modern agricultural practices

benefits.title: Low Premium
benefits.description: Farmers pay a nominal share of premium while the government subsidises the rest

benefits.title: Insurance Payout
benefits.description: Compensation for crop loss due to natural calamities, pests and diseases

otherCriteria: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas, both loanee and non-loanee

Is the crop being cultivated in a notified area under PMFBY for the relevant season?

Are you applying within the prescribed enrolment deadline for the crop/season?

applicationProcess.description: Apply through bank, insurance company or CSC before the cut-off date
Loss assessment conducted in case of crop damage
Claim amount credited to bank account

faqs.question: Is PMFBY mandatory?
faqs.answer: It is compulsory for loanee farmers unless they opt out; voluntary for non-loanee farmers.

faqs.question: What crops are covered?
faqs.answer: Notified food crops, oilseeds and horticultural/commercial crops as per state notification.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)

ministry.name: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
ministry.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

overview: A scheme providing farmers with timely access to affordable credit for cultivation and other agricultural needs through a single credit product.
objectives: Provide adequate and timely credit support to farmers
Cover short-term credit needs for cultivation and allied activities
Simplify farmer access to institutional credit

benefits.title: Short-term Credit
benefits.description: Credit for crop cultivation, post-harvest expenses and farm maintenance

benefits.title: Interest Subvention
benefits.description: Concessional interest rates on prompt repayment

otherCriteria: Farmers, tenant farmers, oral lessees and sharecroppers

applicationProcess.description: Apply at nearest bank branch or through PM-KISAN portal KCC link
Bank assesses and sanctions credit limit
KCC issued with cash credit facility

faqs.question: Which banks issue KCC?
faqs.answer: Commercial banks, cooperative banks and regional rural banks.

faqs.question: Is there interest subvention?
faqs.answer: Yes, farmers repaying on time get interest subvention benefits.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme

ministry.name: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
ministry.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

overview: A scheme to provide farmers with soil health cards containing nutrient status of their soil along with recommendations on appropriate fertiliser dosage to improve productivity.
objectives: Promote soil test based nutrient management
Improve soil health and reduce input costs
Increase agricultural productivity through balanced fertiliser use

benefits.title: Free Soil Testing
benefits.description: Analysis of 12 soil parameters at no cost to farmers

benefits.title: Fertiliser Recommendations
benefits.description: Crop-specific nutrient and fertiliser dosage recommendations

customQuestions.question: Are you a farmer with an agricultural/farm holding?
Do you have an agricultural land/holding for which soil health needs to be assessed?
Are you currently cultivating or managing the agricultural holding?
Can the location of your agricultural holding be identified by the concerned agriculture authorities?
Can you provide your name, mobile number and complete address for farmer registration?
Are you willing to allow an authorized person to collect a soil sample from your field?
Do you want to receive information about the nutrient status and fertilizer/soil-amendment requirements of your holding?

applicationProcess.description: Submit soil sample at nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra or collection centre
Sample tested at a soil testing laboratory
Soil Health Card issued with recommendations

faqs.question: How often is the card issued?
faqs.answer: Typically once every two to three years.

faqs.question: Is there a cost for soil testing?
faqs.answer: No, the service is provided free of cost to farmers.

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)

ministry.name: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare / Ministry of Jal Shakti
ministry.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

overview: A scheme to expand cultivable area under assured irrigation, improve on-farm water use efficiency and promote micro-irrigation technologies such as drip and sprinkler irrigation.
objectives: Ensure access to irrigation for all agricultural farms
Improve water use efficiency through micro-irrigation
Enhance water source creation and its protective use

benefits.title: Irrigation Infrastructure
benefits.description: Support for creation of irrigation sources and water conservation structures

benefits.title: Micro-irrigation Subsidy
benefits.description: Financial assistance for drip and sprinkler irrigation systems

otherCriteria: Farmers seeking irrigation infrastructure or micro-irrigation support

customQuestions.question: Are you a farmer/agricultural landholder seeking irrigation or water-management assistance?

Is the agricultural land located in an area covered by the relevant PMKSY/state implementation plan?
Are you seeking assistance for an eligible activity such as micro-irrigation, irrigation infrastructure, water conservation or watershed development?

If applying for micro-irrigation assistance, are you willing to install an eligible drip or sprinkler irrigation system?  Yes / No / Not Applicable  Yes, if applicable  6  Is the proposed assistance for your own/eligible cultivated agricultural holding?
Is the total area for which you are claiming the applicable beneficiary subsidy within the prescribed 5-hectare ceiling?
Can you provide the required land, farmer and bank/Aadhaar details requested by the implementing authority?

applicationProcess.description: Apply through state agriculture/horticulture department or PMKSY portal
Subsidy released after installation of irrigation system

faqs.question: What does PMKSY cover?
faqs.answer: Watershed development, micro-irrigation and command area development.

faqs.question: Who implements PMKSY?
faqs.answer: Jointly implemented by Ministry of Agriculture and Ministry of Jal Shakti.
